question: Should Signal implicit auto-replies default to native quoting for all eligible replies, with quote-rejection fallback to an ordinary Signal send, in this PR?
rationale: The patch appears technically coherent, but it changes default user-visible Signal reply behavior and approval-reaction routing for existing installs, which requires owner product and upgrade intent rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Accept all-mode native quoting
options.body: Keep the documented unset default of quoting every eligible Signal auto-reply and proceed once the draft receives final maintainer approval.

options.title: Narrow the default before merge
options.body: Change the unset default to a lower-blast-radius mode such as first or off, then update docs, tests, schema, and generated metadata together.

options.title: Pause for a smaller slice
options.body: Split or defer the broader default/session-state behavior and land only a narrower native quote path later.

recommendation.title: Accept all-mode native quoting
recommendation.body: Keep the documented unset default of quoting every eligible Signal auto-reply and proceed once the draft receives final maintainer approval.
